meaning: Classification is for finding saved research, NOT adjudicated component-failure coverage, model rating, market availability, reliability, factory source completeness or OEM-fitment approval.
boundary: Use explicit record subject/predicate/title before research-domain context. Multiple physical systems may coexist; cross-cutting sources/vehicle identity and uncertainty are permitted. Keyword and domain routes are review leads, never certified applicability.

evidence_roles.fact: Documented/supplier/derived technical observation; not by itself a factory failure, supplier inventory or confirmed interchange.
evidence_roles.part: Historical catalogued OEM or supplier part entry; not verified current stock or VIN-approved fitment.
evidence_roles.gap: Unanswered research requirement; not proof vehicle suffers a fault.
evidence_roles.issue: Preexisting case classified by legacy taxonomy; not necessarily a defect.

source_reuse_only: Same original URL in an issue or another record is context for research navigation, not a verified same failure, confirmation of fitment, or a complete repair study.
user_decisions: No tier scores, no model priorities, no assumption excluded platforms are unreliable. Neither a physical component nor vehicle campaign source is automatically repeated as a model-wide defect.
explicit_record_routes_purpose: All saved part IDs were manually checked against their source-scoped part titles for primary SYSTEM NAVIGATION. This is not a manual verification of maker, OE supersession, correct VIN fitment, supplier stock, installation, quality, or service life. Any new part ID needs reviewer classification before CI passes.
explicit_issue_routes_purpose: 32 existing issue narratives with ambiguous automatic routes are reviewed for search/navigation only. Five source-quality, VIN-table, stock provenance and regulator lookup cases have [] because they are deliberately cross-cutting and do not represent a specific broken physical system. This classification does not replace the human-reviewed defect/diagnosis taxonomy or original applicability.
